answer: A microgrid attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks by binding each agent identity to a telemetry node in a solar orchard. To participate, an agent must prove real battery depletion through the nightly power nadir, forcing an attacker to dedicate scarce physical storage cells per identity. Spawning forged personas triggers a capital cost spiral instead of cheap virtualization. However, weather anomalies can distort sensor telemetry, erroneously disqualifying honest agents.
